name: fortinet-fortimanager-json-rpc
label: Fortinet FortiManager JSON RPC
description: The Fortinet FortiManager JSON RPC Connector is an advanced connector with freeform actions to use the JSON-RPC API directly. This connector puts the onus on the user to understand the FortiManager API. To use the connector that simplify actions please see the original Fortinet FortiManager Connector.

fields.name: address
fields.title: Hostname
fields.tooltip: Provide the IP address or Hostname of the FortiManager endpoint server to which you will connect
fields.description: IP address or Hostname of the Fortinet FortiManager endpoint server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Authentication Method
fields.name: auth_method
fields.description: Select the method using which you will authenticate to the Fortinet FortiManager server.

Username/Password.name: username
Username/Password.title: Username
Username/Password.description: Username with JSON-RPC enabled to access the Fortinet FortiManager server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

Username/Password.name: password
Username/Password.title: Password
Username/Password.description: Password to access the Fortinet FortiManager server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

API Key.title: API Key
API Key.name: api_key
API Key.description: API key to access the Fortinet FortiManager server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.name: port
fields.title: Port
fields.description: Port number used to access the Fortinet FortiManager server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations. By default, this is set to 443.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.

fields.name: debug_connection
fields.title: Debug Connection
fields.description: Only used with the json_rpc connections, and enables the debug. This can sometimes cause an I/O operation error since debugging involves printing responses, which writes to the integration.log file.

fields.name: verbose_json
fields.title: Verbose JSON
fields.description: Setting this to true adds a verbose flag to the request, so that the integers are translated to the string representation by FortiManager.

operations.title: Get FortiManager Device Stats
operations.description: Gather comprehensive device statistics including device details, firewall policies, and policy statistics. Automatically merges policy data with statistics for complete visibility.

parameters.name: device_targets
parameters.title: Device Targets
parameters.description: List of device paths to gather statistics from (e.g., ['device/FGT1', 'device/FGT2'])

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.title: VDOM
parameters.description: Virtual domain to query. Defaults to 'root'

parameters.name: include_device_info
parameters.title: Include Device Info
parameters.description: Include device details such as uptime, firmware version, and HA status

parameters.name: include_policies
parameters.title: Include Firewall Policies
parameters.description: Include firewall policy configuration

parameters.name: include_policy_stats
parameters.title: Include Policy Statistics
parameters.description: Include firewall policy statistics (hit count, bytes, packets, etc.)

parameters.name: merge_stats
parameters.title: Merge Stats with Policies
parameters.description: Merge policy statistics into policy data for unified view

parameters.name: policy_fields
parameters.title: Policy Fields
parameters.description: Specific policy fields to retrieve. Leave empty for default fields.

parameters.name: stat_fields
parameters.title: Statistics Fields
parameters.description: Specific statistics fields to retrieve. Leave empty for default fields.
